name: Clockwork Arms

source.title: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

disable: DC 43 Thievery check (master) to jam and deactivate one of the arms or DC 46 Athletics check (legendary) to tear an arm off the machine.
routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action per arm destroyed or disabled. On its turn, the trap makes claw Strikes against creatures other than the Rumormonger or the Inkmaster. If an arm already has a creature grabbed, the trap spends 2 actions to use its Open Hatch ability.

items.name: Arm Activation
items.text:
Trigger The Rumormonger or the Inkmaster enters the room

---

Effect The trap rolls initiative.

items.name: Open Hatch
items.text: The metal hatch opens and the arms deposit a grabbed Medium or smaller creature into the hole. The creature becomes caught in the gears (see Caught in Gears) for 1 round before emerging in area K5. Reset Rewinding the gears for 1d4 minutes resets the trap.

text: Four claw-tipped clockwork arms suspended from the ceiling pick up and deposit creatures into a nearby hatch.
